newsitem.title: USA: Aetna names Joseph Sebastianelli president.
newsitem.headline: Aetna names Joseph Sebastianelli president.

text.p: Aetna Inc said Thursday it named co-president of Aetna U.S. Healthcare and executive vice president Joseph Sebastianelli, as president of the company.
Sebastianelli, 50, would continue to report to Aetna chairman and chief executive officer Ronald Compton, the company said.
Michael Cardillo would now be the sole president of Aetna U.S. Healthcare, the company said.
Cardillo and Frederick Copeland Jr., president of Aetna International, would report to Sebastianelli, it said.

CEO Compton said: "With more than 25 years of high-level experience in the health care field, Joe has done a great job leading the rapid and successful integration of the health business and creating a winning strategy for the health business going forward."
Sebastianelli also was nominated for election to the board by shareholders at the upcoming annual meeting, it said.
